TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Dead Nations Faction.

Translations.Comment: 死の国々 = nations of death. Evokes undead kingdoms rising from ancient graves.
骸骨 = skeleton, 戦士 = warrior. Basic undead infantry with ominous tone.
ゾンビ = zombie (katakana). Shambling undead hordes, universally recognized term.
暗墓 = dark grave/crypt, 守護者 = guardian. Elite undead warriors guarding ancient tombs.
槍兵 = spear warrior. Skeletal troops in disciplined undead formations.
掘り出された = unearthed, 投石機 = catapult. Ancient siege weapon raised from death.
弓兵 = archer/bowman. Undead archers, silent and deadly in unison.
影 = shadow, 狼 = wolf. Supernatural cursed creatures of darkness.
騎士 = knight. Former knights now serving as undead cavalry.
恐怖 = dread/terror. Elite undead knights radiating fear and despair.
凶悪 = fell/dreadful, 蝙蝠 = bat. Monstrous flying creatures of the night.
巨大 = giant/colossal. Massive reanimated corpse of tremendous power.
骨 = bone, 竜 = dragon. Terrifying undead dragon of pure skeletal form.
君主 = lord/ruler. Ancient undead noble commanding vast armies.
吸血鬼 = vampire. Undead knight with vampiric supernatural powers.
死霊 = death spirit/corpse, 術士 = practitioner/sorcerer. Master of death magic.
